lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#5 in EPA per play), while Houston Texans owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#3 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Jacksonville Jaguars -2.2 with a fair total of 41.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Houston Texans pass offence vs Jacksonville Jaguars pass defence, which sits −0.123 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
